unitTitle: Describing Location - Relative Pronouns - Relative Adverbs - Some/Any/No
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 12-UNIT MAShQLAR, 2-BET (60-bet, PDF 59). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '12'.

CHAP USTUN:
4) 'Fill in the gaps with who, which, or where.' 'CLEARVIEW CAMPSITE' (qunduz rasmi): Clearview Campsite, 1) ...... is located on beautiful Beaver Lake, is the ideal place for people 2) ...... want a peaceful holiday close to nature. The campsite, 3) ...... has over 70 tent sites and 50 caravans for hire, is three miles away from Fairton. Each caravan, 4) ...... can sleep up to six people, has a kitchen, shower, toilet, electricity and hot and cold running water. Clearview Campsite also has bathrooms on the campsite 5) ...... campers can take hot showers and wash clothes. The 'Beaver Lake Restaurant' is a place 6) ...... you can eat some of the most delicious fresh fish in the country. For those of you 7) ...... love camping and want to experience a different type of holiday, Clearview Campsite is the perfect choice.
5) 'Denise went to Europe last summer. Match the places she visited to what she did in each place and then make sentences using where, as in the example.' 1 France 2 England 3 Spain 4 Greece 5 Italy 6 Switzerland 7 Germany 8 Monaco 9 Denmark 10 Holland. a enjoy flamenco dancing b see The Little Mermaid c ski in the Alps d visit Buckingham Palace e visit the Eiffel Tower f take pictures of the windmills g admire the Colosseum h eat delicious sausages i travel to the beautiful Aegean islands j watch the Grand Prix. 1 Denise went to France where she visited the Eiffel Tower.

O'NG USTUN - 'Some - Any - No':
6) 'Underline the correct item.' 1 I didn't know somebody/anybody at the wedding except for the bride and groom. 2 Call me when you get home. I have to tell you something/some very important. 3 Paul should do some/any sit-ups every day if he wants to keep fit. 4 Did Mandy find nothing/anything at the shops on Saturday? 5 There aren't some/any glasses in the cupboard. 6 No one/Anyone knew the woman's name. 7 There are any/no eggs in the fridge. 8 We didn't go nowhere/anywhere last night. 9 Is there nothing/anything I can do to help you? 10 I want to go somewhere/anywhere this weekend but I don't know where.
7) 'Fill in some, any, no or their compounds, as in the example.' 1 I haven't eaten any meat for two weeks. 2 ...... was using the phone so I couldn't call you. 3 There are ...... empty seats on the bus so we have to wait for the next one. 4 I would like to buy ...... trendy for the party. 5 It's already 12:00 and I haven't done ...... . 6 We went ...... this weekend because I wasn't feeling well. 7 I didn't see ...... yesterday. 8 Do you want to go ...... to eat tonight? 9 There was ...... interesting to see in the town so we left. 10 ...... houses in my neighbourhood are over 200 years old.
8) 'Choose the correct answer.' 1 A musician is someone ...... plays music. A where B which C who. 2 There are many fantastic bazaars in the city ...... people can buy lovely handmade souvenirs. A where B who C which. 3 Is there ...... to eat? A anybody B anything C anyone.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '60'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with who, which, or where.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni who, which yoki where bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
CLEARVIEW LAGERI - REKLAMA.

  Oldingi so'zga qarang:
  ODAM → who; NARSA/JOY (ot) →
  which; JOY (u yerda) → where

  1 Campsite, WHICH is located
  2 people WHO want
  3 The campsite, WHICH has
  4 Each caravan, WHICH can sleep
  5 bathrooms ... WHERE campers can
    take showers
  6 a place WHERE you can eat
  7 those of you WHO love camping


⚠ 'A CAMPSITE':

  = lager joyi.


⚠ 'FOR HIRE':

  = ijaraga.


⚠ 'RUNNING WATER':

  = oqar suv (vodoprovod).

items.textEn: Clearview Campsite, ___ is located on beautiful Beaver Lake, is the ideal place
for people ___ want a peaceful holiday close to nature.
The campsite, ___ has over 70 tent sites and 50 caravans for hire, is three miles away from Fairton.
Each caravan, ___ can sleep up to six people, has a kitchen, shower, toilet, electricity and hot and cold running water.
Clearview Campsite also has bathrooms on the campsite ___ campers can take hot showers and wash clothes.
The 'Beaver Lake Restaurant' is a place ___ you can eat some of the most delicious fresh fish in the country.
For those of you ___ love camping and want to experience a different type of holiday, Clearview Campsite is the perfect choice.

exercises.instructionEn: Denise went to Europe last summer. Match the places she visited to what she did in each place and then make sentences using where, as in the example. 1 France 2 England 3 Spain 4 Greece 5 Italy 6 Switzerland 7 Germany 8 Monaco 9 Denmark 10 Holland. a enjoy flamenco dancing b see The Little Mermaid c ski in the Alps d visit Buckingham Palace e visit the Eiffel Tower f take pictures of the windmills g admire the Colosseum h eat delicious sausages i travel to the beautiful Aegean islands j watch the Grand Prix. 1 Denise went to France where she visited the Eiffel Tower.
exercises.instructionUz: Deniz o'tgan yozda Yevropaga bordi. U borgan joylarni u yerda nima qilganiga moslang va where bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 Fransiya 2 Angliya 3 Ispaniya 4 Gretsiya 5 Italiya 6 Shveytsariya 7 Germaniya 8 Monako 9 Daniya 10 Gollandiya. a flamenko raqsidan zavqlanish b 'Kichik suv parisi'ni ko'rish c Alp tog'larida chang'i uchish d Bukingem saroyini ziyorat qilish e Eyfel minorasini ziyorat qilish f shamol tegirmonlarini suratga olish g Kolizeyga qoyil qolish h mazali sosiskalar yeyish i go'zal Egey orollariga sayohat j Gran-prini tomosha qilish. 1 Deniz Fransiyaga bordi, u yerda Eyfel minorasini ziyorat qildi.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAMLAKAT + WHERE + NIMA QILDI.

  1 France - e Eiffel Tower
  2 England - d Buckingham Palace
  3 Spain - a flamenco
  4 Greece - i Aegean islands
  5 Italy - g Colosseum
  6 Switzerland - c ski in the
    Alps
  7 Germany - h sausages
  8 Monaco - j Grand Prix
  9 Denmark - b The Little Mermaid
  10 Holland - f windmills

  ⚠ Fe'l o'tgan zamonda: visited,
  enjoyed, saw, skied, took,
  admired, ate, travelled, watched.


⚠ 'THE LITTLE MERMAID':

  = 'Kichik suv parisi' haykali
  (Kopengagen).


⚠ 'THE GRAND PRIX':

  = Formula-1 poygasi (Monako).

exercises.explanationUz:
SOME- (tasdiq) / ANY- (savol,
  inkor) / NO- (inkor, fe'l
  tasdiqda).

  1 didn't know ANYBODY (inkor)
  2 tell you SOMETHING (tasdiq)
  3 do SOME sit-ups (tasdiq)
  4 Did ... find ANYTHING (savol)
  5 aren't ANY glasses (inkor)
  6 NO ONE knew (fe'l tasdiqda)
  7 There are NO eggs (fe'l
    tasdiqda)
  8 didn't go ANYWHERE (inkor)
  9 Is there ANYTHING (savol)
  10 go SOMEWHERE (tasdiq)


⚠ 'THE BRIDE AND GROOM':

  = kelin va kuyov.


⚠ 'SIT-UPS':

  = press mashqi.

items.textEn: I didn't know somebody/anybody at the wedding except for the bride and groom.
items.uz: To'yda kelin-kuyovdan boshqa hech kimni tanimasdim.

items.textEn: Call me when you get home. I have to tell you something/some very important.
items.uz: Uyga kelganingda qo'ng'iroq qil. Senga juda muhim narsa aytishim kerak.

items.textEn: Paul should do some/any sit-ups every day if he wants to keep fit.
items.uz: Pol baquvvat bo'lishni xohlasa, har kuni press mashqi qilishi kerak.

items.textEn: Did Mandy find nothing/anything at the shops on Saturday?
items.uz: Mendi shanba kuni do'konlardan biror narsa topdimi?

items.textEn: There aren't some/any glasses in the cupboard.
No one/Anyone knew the woman's name.
There are any/no eggs in the fridge.
We didn't go nowhere/anywhere last night.
Is there nothing/anything I can do to help you?
items.uz: Sizga yordam berish uchun biror narsa qila olamanmi?

items.textEn: I want to go somewhere/anywhere this weekend but I don't know where.
items.uz: Bu dam olish kuni qayergadir borgim kelyapti, lekin qayerga - bilmayman.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in some, any, no or their compounds, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Some, any, no yoki ularning hosilalarini qo'ying, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
MA'NO va GAP TURIGA QARANG.

  1 haven't eaten ANY meat (NAMUNA)
  2 SOMEONE was using the phone
    (kimdir - tasdiq)
  3 There are NO empty seats (fe'l
    tasdiqda, ma'no inkor)
  4 buy SOMETHING trendy (tasdiq)
  5 haven't done ANYTHING (inkor)
  6 We went NOWHERE (fe'l tasdiqda
    - hech qayerga)
  7 didn't see ANYONE / ANYBODY
    (inkor)
  8 go SOMEWHERE / ANYWHERE to eat
    (savol - taklif)
  9 There was NOTHING interesting
    (fe'l tasdiqda)
  10 SOME houses (tasdiq)


⚠ 'TRENDY':

  = zamonaviy, modaga mos.

items.textEn: I haven't eaten ___ meat for two weeks.
___ was using the phone so I couldn't call you.
There are ___ empty seats on the bus so we have to wait for the next one.
I would like to buy ___ trendy for the party.
It's already 12:00 and I haven't done ___.
We went ___ this weekend because I wasn't feeling well.
I didn't see ___ yesterday.
Do you want to go ___ to eat tonight?
There was ___ interesting to see in the town so we left.
___ houses in my neighbourhood are over 200 years old.

exercises.explanationUz:
WHO / WHICH / WHERE va ANY-
  HOSILALARI.

  1 someone WHO plays (odam)
  2 the city WHERE people can buy
    (joy)
  3 Is there ANYTHING to eat?
    (narsa, savol)


⚠ 'A BAZAAR':

  = bozor (sharqona).


⚠ 'HANDMADE':

  = qo'lda yasalgan.

items.textEn: A musician is someone ___ plays music.
There are many fantastic bazaars in the city ___ people can buy lovely handmade souvenirs.
items.uz: Shaharda odamlar qo'lda yasalgan esdaliklar sotib oladigan ko'p ajoyib bozorlar bor.

items.textEn: Is there ___ to eat?

patterns.formula: KIM + went to + JOY + where + KIM + V2 ...
patterns.exampleEn: Denise went to France where she visited the Eiffel Tower.
patterns.exampleUz: Deniz Fransiyaga bordi, u yerda Eyfel minorasini ziyorat qildi.

patterns.exampleEn: Each caravan, which can sleep up to six people, has a kitchen.
patterns.exampleUz: Har bir karavan, olti kishi sig'adigan, oshxonaga ega.

patterns.formula: There is nothing / nobody ... (fe'l tasdiqda) = There isn't anything / anybody ...
patterns.exampleEn: There was nothing interesting to see. No one knew the woman's name.
patterns.exampleUz: Ko'rgulik hech narsa yo'q edi. Hech kim ayolning ismini bilmasdi.
